result.note: Tested the country behind the US sanctions on Indian firms and the Russian supply assurance from the same week.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about developments in August 2026:
items: Under Operation Economic Outcast, the United States sanctioned four India-based firms over alleged trade in Venezuelan petroleum.
Russian President Putin promised External Affairs Minister Jaishankar sustained fuel and fertiliser supplies.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the four India-based firms were sanctioned over alleged Iranian petroleum trade, not Venezuelan. In the same week, Putin assured Jaishankar of continued fuel and fertiliser supplies to India.
questions.source: The United States sanctioned four India-based firms over alleged Iranian petroleum trade under Operation Economic Outcast, even as Putin promised Jaishankar sustained fuel and fertiliser supplies.
